sections.h2: Sandbridge Beach Home Prices and Market Pace
sections.html:
In the 24 months from November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026, 140 residential sales closed in Sandbridge Beach (Virginia Beach, VA) according to REIN MLS records. The median sold price was $1,032,500, well above the citywide median of $405,000, and homes took a median of 56 days to sell, slower than the citywide median of 15 days. These figures come from closed sales, which show what homes actually sold for rather than asking prices.

The middle half of Sandbridge Beach sales closed between $515,000 and $1,511,250, or about $399 per square foot against $240 citywide. Split by year, the median sold price in the most recent 12 months ($1,050,000, 85 sales) was about 5% higher than in the earlier 12 months ($1,000,000, 55 sales). Typical homes sold at about 97.0% of list price (median sale-to-list ratio), which gives buyers some negotiating room.

Recent Sandbridge Beach sales were in ZIP code 23456.

sections.h2: What Stands Out About Sandbridge Beach
sections.html: At a median $399 per square foot, Sandbridge Beach sits 67% above the $240 citywide figure. 7% of Sandbridge Beach homes sold for more than their list price, versus 36% citywide, so sellers here more often accepted less than the asking price. 22% of Sandbridge Beach homes went under contract within 14 days of listing, compared with 49% of Virginia Beach sales overall.

sections.h2: What Kinds of Homes Sell in Sandbridge Beach
sections.html:
56% of the sales were detached homes and 44% were attached homes (townhomes or condos). The median home was about 2,260 square feet, with the middle half of sales running from roughly 1,598 to 3,128 square feet. 28% of the homes that sold had 4 bedrooms.

Most homes that sold were built between 1972 and 2007, with a median year built of 2004, so this is a mix of homes from the 1990s to the 2010s.
